definition: Fraction of a year a satellite spends outside Earth's shadow.
method: Satellite Inference orbit model v3.1: J2 sun-synchronous inclination, low-precision solar ephemeris for 2027, beta angle and cylindrical Earth-shadow eclipse fraction, integrated over the year.
limitations: Screening model, not mission analysis. Ignores penumbra, atmospheric refraction, attitude and local obstructions. The SI-P1 pathfinder flies in its host's orbit.

orbits.label: Dawn–dusk, 650 km
orbits.note: Sun-synchronous; our model orbit for SI Nodes
